title: Roman Mars Describes Things As They Are

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九的隐形。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Hello, beautiful, homebound nerds.
sentences.zh: 你们好，美丽而深居简出的极客们。

sentences.en: If I sound a little different, it's because I'm recording this at home.
sentences.zh: 如果我的声音听起来有点不同，那是因为我是从家里录制的。

sentences.en: You might even hear some cars passing by.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可能会听到一些汽车驶过的声音。

sentences.en: I'm not sick.
sentences.zh: 我没有生病。

sentences.en: Hopefully, neither are you.
sentences.zh: 希望你们也没有。

sentences.en: But many of us are staying home so that we don't inadvertently become vectors to a virus
sentences.zh: 但我们许多人都在呆在家里，这样我们就不会无意中成为病毒的载体

sentences.en: whose impact we don't fully understand.
sentences.zh: 我们对其影响尚不完全了解。

sentences.en: This is the right thing to do.
sentences.zh: 这是正确的事情。

sentences.en: We are all part of one big ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 我们都是一个大生态系统的一部分。

sentences.en: And if any part of us gets sick, we all suffer.
sentences.zh: 如果我们中的任何一部分生病，我们所有人都会痛苦。

sentences.en: We are in this together.
sentences.zh: 我们同舟共济。

sentences.en: So, my job in this world is to tell stories about all the thought that goes into the things
sentences.zh: 所以，我在这个世界上的工作是讲述关于所有深入思考的故事

sentences.en: most people don't think about.
sentences.zh: 大多数人不会想到的事情。

sentences.en: And since many of us are stuck at home, maybe alone, maybe lonely,
sentences.zh: 既然我们许多人都被困在家中，也许一个人，也许很孤独，

sentences.en: I thought we'd spend some time exploring this place we call home together.
sentences.zh: 我想我们可以花点时间一起探索这个我们称之为家的地方。

sentences.en: Just you and me.
sentences.zh: 只有你和我。

sentences.en: Sound good?
sentences.zh: 听起来不错吧？

sentences.en: If you answer back out loud, I won't think you're weird.
sentences.zh: 如果你大声回答，我不会觉得你很奇怪。

sentences.en: I am starting in my bedroom.
sentences.zh: 我从我的卧室开始。

sentences.en: I'm sitting on a Casper mattress.
sentences.zh: 我坐在卡斯帕床垫上。

sentences.en: This is not an ad.
sentences.zh: 这不是广告。

sentences.en: We eat our own dog food in the podcast business, so I have a Casper mattress.
sentences.zh: 我们在播客行业自产自销，所以我有一个卡斯帕床垫。

sentences.en: But I digress.
sentences.zh: 言归正传。

sentences.en: As I look around, I see I have five windows in this room.
sentences.zh: 当我环顾四周时，我看到这个房间里有五扇窗户。

sentences.en: Now, if I were in England or France or Ireland or Scotland during the 18th and 19th centuries,
sentences.zh: 现在，如果我在 18 世纪和 19 世纪的英格兰、法国、爱尔兰或苏格兰，

sentences.en: I would probably not want this many windows.
sentences.zh: 我可能不想要这么多窗户。

sentences.en: That's because back then, the more windows you had, the more tax you paid.
sentences.zh: 那是因为在那个时候，你拥有的窗户越多，你付出的税就越多。

sentences.en: This was all variable from place to place and over time, but the principle was that a window
sentences.zh: 这一切因地而异，也随时间而变化，但原则是窗户

sentences.en: tax was a good stand-in for a progressive income tax.
sentences.zh: 税是累进所得税的良好替代品。

sentences.en: The bigger the house, the more windows, the higher the tax you paid.
sentences.zh: 房子越大，窗户越多，你付出的税就越高。

sentences.en: When the window tax was instituted in 1696 in England and Wales, a home was taxed at a
sentences.zh: 1696 年，当窗户税在英格兰和威尔士制定时，房屋按以下方式纳税：

sentences.en: regular flat rate and then taxed an extra amount for each window over 10 windows that it had.
sentences.zh: 常规固定税率，然后对超过 10 个窗户的每个窗户征收额外金额。

sentences.en: Like I said, the number of windows and the amount of tax varied a lot over time, but the
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，窗户的数量和税额随着时间而变化很大，但

sentences.en: tax was pretty easy to assess by an outside observer.
sentences.zh: 外部观察员很容易评估税收。

sentences.en: It was certainly considered easier to assess than an income tax, and so it persisted for
sentences.zh: 它当然被认为比所得税更容易评估，因此它持续了

sentences.en: quite some time in some places into the 20th century.
sentences.zh: 在某些地方一直持续到 20 世纪的相当长一段时间。

sentences.en: This had a funny side effect on architecture that you can still see today in some buildings
sentences.zh: 这对建筑产生了有趣的影响，你今天仍然可以在一些建筑中看到它

sentences.en: in the UK and in Europe.
sentences.zh: 在英国和欧洲。

sentences.en: There are many instances of window spaces that are completely bricked up to avoid a tax
sentences.zh: 有很多窗户空间完全用砖砌起来的例子，以避免纳税

sentences.en: from 100 years ago.
sentences.zh: 从 100 年前开始。

sentences.en: Now, if you passed one in your neighborhood, it means some tax cheat lived there a long time
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你在附近经过一个，这意味着很久以前有一些逃税者住在那里

sentences.en: ago or, you know, an enterprising lifehacker lived there, you know, depending on your perspective.
sentences.zh: 或者，你知道，一个足智多谋的生活黑客住在那里，你知道，取决于你的观点。

sentences.en: On a chest of drawers next to my bed sits an oscillating fan that I've had for about 35
sentences.zh: 在我床旁边的一个抽屉柜上放着一个我用了大约 35 年的振荡风扇

sentences.en: years.
sentences.zh: 年。

sentences.en: It still works really well.
sentences.zh: 它仍然运行得很好。

sentences.en: It's a wind mirror.
sentences.zh: 这是一个风镜。

sentences.en: I've done a little Googling, and honestly, I cannot tell you if this company still exists.
sentences.zh: 我做了一些谷歌搜索，老实说，我无法告诉你这家公司是否还存在。

sentences.en: The fan mostly points away from the bed.
sentences.zh: 风扇主要背对床。

sentences.en: I just use it for white noise when I sleep.
sentences.zh: 我睡觉时只是用它来发出白噪音。

sentences.en: If I were in Korea, running a fan in an enclosed bedroom might be discouraged by older generations.
sentences.zh: 如果我在韩国，在封闭的卧室里开风扇可能会遭到老一代人的反对。

sentences.en: There is, by some accounts, still a widespread belief in Korea that fans cause death.
sentences.zh: 据一些人说，韩国仍然普遍存在风扇会导致死亡的信念。

sentences.en: No one seems to know how this myth started.
sentences.zh: 似乎没有人知道这个神话是如何开始的。

sentences.en: Maybe fans are just an innocent bystander to too many heat-related deaths, but nonetheless,
sentences.zh: 也许风扇只是太多与热有关的死亡的无辜旁观者，但尽管如此，

sentences.en: the fear persists.
sentences.zh: 恐惧依然存在。

sentences.en: I remember when I was a kid growing up in the southern US, I was told that if you slept
sentences.zh: 我记得当我还是个在美国南部长大的孩子时，有人告诉我，如果你在夏天睡觉

sentences.en: with a fan blowing on you in the summer, you'd catch a summer cold, which is just as unfounded.
sentences.zh: 夏天开着风扇吹向你，你会得夏季感冒，这同样是没有根据的。

sentences.en: But still, nowhere does fan equal death like Korea.
sentences.zh: 但是，没有任何地方的风扇等于像韩国这样的死亡。

sentences.en: Well, I'm going to get up from the bed, and let's go ahead and walk into the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我要从床上起来，让我们继续走进浴室。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So there is the toilet.
sentences.zh: 所以那是马桶。

sentences.en: There is an extremely common misconception that the toilet was invented by a man named
sentences.zh: 有一个极其普遍的误解，认为马桶是由一个名叫

sentences.en: Thomas Crapper.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·克拉珀。

sentences.en: Crapper was a sanitation engineer and entrepreneur in the UK in the late 19th century that held
sentences.zh: 克拉珀是 19 世纪后期英国的卫生工程师和企业家，他持有

sentences.en: a few patents, and he's credited with improving indoor plumbing for toilets.
sentences.zh: 获得了一些专利，他被认为是改进了马桶的室内管道。

sentences.en: He was a good businessman, and by all accounts, he installed and sold a lot of plumbing supplies
sentences.zh: 他是个好商人，据各方报道，他安装并销售了大量的管道用品

sentences.en: with the name Crapper and company on them.
sentences.zh: 上面写着克拉珀和公司。

sentences.en: No one is quite sure why he gets so much credit for the flushing toilet, but I think it's because
sentences.zh: 没有人确切知道为什么他会为抽水马桶获得如此多的功劳，但我认为这是因为

sentences.en: his name was Crapper.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫克拉珀。

sentences.en: Crapper, as a term for bodily excrement, was already in use for decades before he made toilet
sentences.zh: 克拉珀作为身体排泄物的术语，在他制造马桶之前已经使用了几十年

sentences.en: parts.
sentences.zh: 部件。

sentences.en: So sometimes destiny just smiles upon you.
sentences.zh: 所以有时命运只是对你微笑。

sentences.en: While we're here in the bathroom, let's wash our hands.
sentences.zh: 当我们在浴室时，让我们洗手。

sentences.en: That's good COVID-19 protocol.
sentences.zh: 这是很好的 2019 冠状病毒病方案。

sentences.en: Soap is one of those inventions that is so monumental, it's hard to even fathom.
sentences.zh: 肥皂是那些具有划时代意义的发明之一，简直难以想象。

sentences.en: It's so ancient.
sentences.zh: 它是如此古老。

sentences.en: No one knows who first discovered it.
sentences.zh: 没有人知道是谁首先发现了它。

sentences.en: There was a very good explainer on soap recently in the New York Times by Ferris Jaber.
sentences.zh: 费里斯·贾伯最近在《纽约时报》上对肥皂进行了很好的解释。

sentences.en: Soap molecules look like little sperm with a head that loves water and a tail that hates
sentences.zh: 肥皂分子看起来像小精子，头部喜欢水，尾巴讨厌

sentences.en: water.
sentences.zh: 水。

sentences.en: So when you put soap and water on your hands, these little soap tails find things that aren't
sentences.zh: 因此，当你把肥皂和水弄到手上时，这些小肥皂尾巴会发现不是

sentences.en: water and they dig their tails in to try to get away.
sentences.zh: 水，他们把尾巴挖进去，试图逃跑。

sentences.en: This breaks up bacteria and virus cell membranes and surrounds any debris with soap molecules
sentences.zh: 这会破坏细菌和病毒细胞膜，并用肥皂分子包围任何碎片

sentences.en: and makes them easy to rinse away when more water and friction are applied.
sentences.zh: 并在施加更多的水和摩擦时使它们易于冲洗掉。

sentences.en: For the sake of your own health and for everyone else's, wash your hands regularly for at least
sentences.zh: 为了你自己的健康和每个人的健康，经常洗手至少

sentences.en: 20 seconds.
That is longer than you think.
sentences.zh: 这比你想象的要长。

sentences.en: So pick a song to keep you on task.
sentences.zh: 所以选一首歌来让你专注于任务。

sentences.en: Long before I had you in my dreams, you came and captured my imagination.
sentences.zh: 早在我在梦中拥有你之前，你就来抓住了我的想象力。

sentences.en: Though some things are never what they seem, I never have to worry cause I know you are.
sentences.zh: 虽然有些事情从来都不是他们看起来的那样，但我永远不必担心，因为我知道你是。

sentences.en: Better than a Venus to Milo in a G-string, better than the promise of a good one night thing,
sentences.zh: 比穿着丁字裤的维纳斯更好，比美好一夜情的承诺更好，

sentences.en: better than a big book of Betty Page pictures, even if it comes with a year subscription,
sentences.zh: 比贝蒂·佩奇图片的大书更好，即使它附带一年订阅，

sentences.en: better than a ticket to a Holyfield ringside, better than a daughter for a sultan for a bride,
sentences.zh: 比霍利菲尔德场边票更好，比苏丹的新娘女儿更好，

sentences.en: better than a cherry on a whipped cream sundae, better than a week that'll never have a Monday.
sentences.zh: 比奶油圣代上的樱桃更好，比永远不会有星期一的一周更好。

sentences.en: Okay, that'll do.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这就够了。

sentences.en: Okay, what's next?
sentences.zh: 好吧，接下来是什么？

sentences.en: Let's walk down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 让我们走下楼梯。

sentences.en: And we are entering the hall.
sentences.zh: 我们正在进入大厅。

sentences.en: In his book, At Home, Bill Bryson wrote that no room has fallen further in history than the
sentences.zh: 比尔·布赖森在他的《在家》一书中写道，历史上的房间没有哪个比

sentences.en: hall.
sentences.zh: 大厅。

sentences.en: I always remember that line.
sentences.zh: 我总是记得那句话。

sentences.en: I've been to Stirling Castle in Scotland a few times, and I love it there, especially
sentences.zh: 我去过苏格兰的斯特灵城堡好几次，我很喜欢那里，尤其是

sentences.en: the Great Hall, which has been painted a shocking and delightful buttery yellow since its restoration
sentences.zh: 大厅，自修复以来一直被涂成令人震惊和愉快的黄油黄色

sentences.en: in the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 在 20 世纪 90 年代。

sentences.en: We did a story about it a few years ago.
sentences.zh: 几年前我们做了一个关于它的故事。

sentences.en: You should check it out.
sentences.zh: 你应该去看看。

sentences.en: Um, it seems impossible that a hall like the one in Stirling Castle and the hall in your
sentences.zh: 嗯，像斯特灵城堡那样的大厅和你的大厅似乎是不可能的

sentences.en: house have a shared origin, but they do.
sentences.zh: 房子有共同的起源，但它们确实有。

sentences.en: The hall used to be everything.
sentences.zh: 大厅曾经是一切。

sentences.en: From the Middle Ages to about the 15th century, the hall was effectively the house, with a
sentences.zh: 从中古时期到大约 15 世纪，大厅实际上就是房子，有一个

sentences.en: central hearth that people used to warm themselves and cook over.
sentences.zh: 人们用来取暖和做饭的中央炉床。

sentences.en: All activity took place there, awake and asleep.
sentences.zh: 所有的活动都在那里发生，醒着和睡着。

sentences.en: As soon as a second room was added to homes, the hall has been on a downhill slide.
sentences.zh: 房屋一增加第二个房间，大厅就一直在走下坡路。

sentences.en: Now, it is this dumb thing, a non-room room, whose primary function is to connect other
sentences.zh: 现在，它是这个哑巴东西，一个非房间房间，其主要功能是连接其他

sentences.en: rooMs.
sentences.zh: 房间。

sentences.en: So, you know, pour one out for the hall.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，为大厅倒出一杯。

sentences.en: If I turn right, I enter the living room.
sentences.zh: 如果我向右转，我进入客厅。

sentences.en: I've got TV, I've got a bunch of article furniture.
sentences.zh: 我有电视，我有很多文章家具。

sentences.en: I have an all-in-one laser printer scanner or copier in here.
sentences.zh: 我这里有一台多功能激光打印机扫描仪或复印机。

sentences.en: Printers are curious technology because they are amazing and everyone hates them.
sentences.zh: 打印机是奇特的科技，因为它们很棒，每个人都讨厌它们。

sentences.en: There are admittedly a lot of things to hate.
sentences.zh: 不可否认，有很多事情要恨。

sentences.en: The criminal price of ink is a big one and paper jams are another.
sentences.zh: 墨水的犯罪价格是一个很大的问题，卡纸是另一个问题。

sentences.en: According to an article in the New Yorker called Why Paper Jams Persist, desktop printers
sentences.zh: 根据《纽约客》上一篇名为《为什么卡纸挥之不去》的文章，桌面打印机

sentences.en: will probably always have paper jaMs.
sentences.zh: 可能永远会有卡纸。

sentences.en: The problem isn't really the printer.
sentences.zh: 问题其实不在于打印机。

sentences.en: It's the paper.
sentences.zh: 这是纸。

sentences.en: Paper is an organic substance that has different properties of thickness and texture depending
sentences.zh: 纸是一种有机物质，根据其厚度和质地具有不同的特性

sentences.en: on what kind of tree it came from and how it's processed.
sentences.zh: 它来自哪种树以及它是如何加工的。

sentences.en: Commercial printers, like the ones you see in the movies, at newspapers, where, you know,
sentences.zh: 商业打印机，就像你在电影中看到的那样，在报纸上，你知道，

sentences.en: someone gets to say, stop the presses.
sentences.zh: 有人可以说，停止印刷机。

sentences.en: Well, they have these long stretches where the paper goes in a straight line and, you
sentences.zh: 好吧，他们有这些长段，纸张走直线，并且，你

sentences.en: know, gets ink put on it.
sentences.zh: 知道，把墨水涂在上面。

sentences.en: But a desktop printer has to do everything in a tiny box.
sentences.zh: 但是桌面打印机必须在一个微小的盒子做所有事情。

sentences.en: So the paper is pulled off the tray and makes a tight turn.
sentences.zh: 因此，纸张从托盘中拉出并急转弯。

sentences.en: It gets rolled onto an ink drum where the image gets put on.
sentences.zh: 它被卷到墨水鼓上，图像被放在上面。

sentences.en: Then it gets heated to almost 800 degrees Fahrenheit to fuse the ink to the page.
sentences.zh: 然后它被加热到接近 800 华氏度，将墨水融合到页面上。

sentences.en: And if you're printing double-sided paper, it stops and turns and gets turned again.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在打印双面纸，它会停止并转动并再次转动。

sentences.en: Then it gets rolled and heated and it gets spit out.
sentences.zh: 然后它被滚动和加热并吐出。

sentences.en: It's like truly a marvel that it works at all.
sentences.zh: 它确实是一个奇迹，它完全工作。

sentences.en: The first commercially available copier, the hulking Xerox 914, which everyone loved and
sentences.zh: 第一台市售复印机，庞大的施乐 914，每个人都喜欢并

sentences.en: made Xerox billions of dollars, caught fire so often that it shipped with a small fire
sentences.zh: 为施乐赚了数十亿美元，起火太频繁了，以至于它配备了一个小型火灾

sentences.en: extinguisher.
sentences.zh: 灭火器。

sentences.en: So things could definitely be worse.
sentences.zh: 所以情况肯定会更糟。

sentences.en: Light bulbs.
sentences.zh: 灯泡。

sentences.en: So we have a really good story that John Wellam wrote about the oldest continuously glowing
sentences.zh: 所以我们有一个非常好的故事，约翰·韦勒姆写关于最古老的连续发光的故事

sentences.en: light bulb that's been in a fire station in Livermore, California for over 100 years.
sentences.zh: 在加利福尼亚州利弗莫尔的消防站里待了 100 多年的灯泡。

sentences.en: I don't really remember the details, so you should just find the episode and listen.
sentences.zh: 我真的不记得细节了，所以你应该找个剧集听听。

sentences.en: It's good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: But I do remember this one light bulb joke.
sentences.zh: 不过我还记得一个灯泡笑话。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: How many psychiatrists does it take to change a light bulb?
sentences.zh: 换一个灯泡需要几个精神病医生？

sentences.en: One.
sentences.zh: 一个。

sentences.en: But the light bulb has to want to change.
sentences.zh: 但灯泡自己得想要改变。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: You can tell that one to the kids.
sentences.zh: 这个你可以讲给孩子们听。

sentences.en: I'm going to walk into the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我要走进厨房了。

sentences.en: Oh, I have a good one here.
sentences.zh: 哦，我这儿有一个好玩的。

sentences.en: This is good.
sentences.zh: 这个很不错。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I'm going to open up this drawer here that you might recognize the sound of.
sentences.zh: 我要打开这个你可能听过声音的抽屉。

sentences.en: That is the silverware drawer.
sentences.zh: 那是放银器的抽屉。

sentences.en: I have spoons, knives, and forks in here.
sentences.zh: 我这里面有勺子、刀子和叉子。

sentences.en: Of these three common pieces of cutlery, the fork is by far the most recent addition to
sentences.zh: 在这三种常见的餐具中，叉子绝对是最晚加入

sentences.en: the tableware family by probably like thousands of years.
sentences.zh: 餐具家族的，大概晚了有几千年吧。

sentences.en: Straight two-pronged forks were used in cooking for carving and getting things off of a fire,
sentences.zh: 早期的两齿叉曾被用于烹饪，用来烤肉以及把食物从火上取下来，

sentences.en: but for a long time, they weren't on the dinner table itself.
sentences.zh: 但在很长一段时间里，它们并没有出现在餐桌上。

sentences.en: People used spoons, knives, and just, you know, their fingers instead.
sentences.zh: 人们用勺子、刀子，还有，你知道的，直接用手指。

sentences.en: Forks were introduced a few times, you know, by fancy people, and they were often ridiculed
sentences.zh: 叉子曾几次被一些讲究的人引入使用，你知道的，他们为此常常遭到群嘲，

sentences.en: for it, but they only really took off when they evolved to have a little bit of curve
sentences.zh: 但它们真正流行起来，是在设计上做出了改进——带有了一点微小的弧度

sentences.en: in them and the extra tines so they could be more versatile for scooping and spearing
sentences.zh: 以及额外的齿尖，这样在盘子里舀取和插起

sentences.en: small things on a plate.
sentences.zh: 小块食物时就能更加灵活多用。

sentences.en: The curious thing about the evolution of the fork is how it changed the design of the knife.
sentences.zh: 关于叉子的演变，最奇妙的是它改变了刀的设计。

sentences.en: For millennia, table knives always had pointed ends for spearing food, but with the fork there,
sentences.zh: 几千年来，餐刀总是带有尖头用来刺取食物，但有了叉子之后，

sentences.en: that function of the knife was redundant, so it could be eliminated.
sentences.zh: 刀的这个功能就变得多余了，因此可以被取消。

sentences.en: In 1669, King Louis XIV of France decreed all pointed dinner table knives illegal, you know,
sentences.zh: 1669年，法国国王路易十四颁布法令，宣布所有尖头餐刀均为非法，你知道的，

sentences.en: to stop people from stabbing each other, which I guess was a problem then.
sentences.zh: 是为了阻止人们互相刺杀，我猜这在当时是个挺严重的问题。

sentences.en: So all new knives were made to have rounded tips, and all existing table knives were to be rounded
sentences.zh: 于是所有的新刀都被做成圆头的，所有现有的餐刀也都必须磨圆，

sentences.en: off to reduce their potential for violence.
sentences.zh: 以减少潜在的暴力危险。

sentences.en: It's this style of knife spread across the world, which is why knives in your drawer, unless
sentences.zh: 正是这种款式的刀流传到了世界各地，这就是为什么你抽屉里的刀，除非

sentences.en: they're a specialty knife, probably have blunt ends.
sentences.zh: 它们是特种刀具，否则通常都是钝头的。

sentences.en: Okay, so I'm going to save some stuff for the kitchen for the next time we do this, if
sentences.zh: 好了，所以我打算把厨房里的一些内容留到我们下次再做这个节目的时候，如果

sentences.en: we need to do this, and we're going to end up back in the living room at the record player
sentences.zh: 我们还得做的话，接下来我们要回到客厅的电唱机旁。

sentences.en: after this.
sentences.zh: 之后。

sentences.en: One of the things I love about vinyl records is that you can see how they work.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢黑胶唱片的原因之一，就是你能看到它们是如何运作的。

sentences.en: A needle reads the vibrations in a groove.
sentences.zh: 唱针读取音轨中的振动。

sentences.en: That vibration moves a magnet that interacts with a couple of electromagnetic coils, and
sentences.zh: 这种振动带动磁铁与几组电磁线圈产生相互作用，

sentences.en: the signal that's generated is amplified a couple times, and it's sent to the speakers.
sentences.zh: 生成的信号经过几次放大后，被输送到扬声器中。

sentences.en: If my phone stops playing music, there is no hope of me getting it to work.
sentences.zh: 如果我的手机停止播放音乐，我是完全没指望能修好它的。

sentences.en: But if everything in the world fails, I have this fantasy that I can put together a crappy
sentences.zh: 但如果世上的一切都崩溃了，我有一种幻想，就是逼不得已时我也能拼凑出一台破旧的

sentences.en: record player if I had to, and that gives me some measure of comfort.
sentences.zh: 电唱机，这能给我带来一定程度的慰藉。

sentences.en: So I want to play the song Exit Without Saving by the band Beauty Pill from their album Beauty
sentences.zh: 所以我想播放这首由 Beauty Pill 乐队带来的《Exit Without Saving》，出自他们的专辑

sentences.en: Pill Describes Things As They Are, which is where I got the name for this episode.
sentences.zh: 《Beauty Pill Describes Things As They Are》，这也是本期节目名称的灵感来源。

sentences.en: Chad Clark is the lead singer and songwriter of Beauty Pill.
sentences.zh: 查德·克拉克（Chad Clark）是 Beauty Pill 的主唱兼词曲作者。

sentences.en: Over a decade ago, his heart got infected by a virus that nearly killed him.
sentences.zh: 十多年前，他的心脏感染了一种差点要了命的病毒。

sentences.en: Every sickness he's had since then has been a risk to his life, and often involved him
sentences.zh: 自那以后，他得的每一次病都对生命构成了威胁，并且常常导致他

sentences.en: being hospitalized for days or weeks at a time.
sentences.zh: 住院治疗长达数日甚至数周。

sentences.en: He has been blunt in saying that the new coronavirus would kill him if he got it.
sentences.zh: 他曾直言不讳地说，如果感染了新的冠状病毒，他会因此丧命。

sentences.en: So, you know, I know it's hard to go through this quarantine and act in the collective good
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我知道经历这次隔离并为了集体利益采取行动很难，

sentences.en: when the action that we're all taking is staying inside and minimizing contact and not, you
sentences.zh: 当我们所有人都在采取的行动是待在家里、尽量减少接触，而不是像

sentences.en: know, like gathering 10 people to lift a car off someone.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，召集10个人去把压在某人身上的汽车抬起来那样。

sentences.en: But taking care in this way is how we can do the most good.
sentences.zh: 但以这种方式小心行事，就是我们能做出的最大贡献。

sentences.en: So you can help me lift a car off my friend Chad Clark, because I need him to stay in this
sentences.zh: 所以你可以帮我把一辆车从我的朋友查德·克拉克身上移开，因为我需要他留在这个

sentences.en: world and keep making music.
sentences.zh: 世界上，继续创作音乐。

sentences.en: And what's amazing is, at the same time, we're lifting a car off your 70-year-old mom and nurse
sentences.zh: 而神奇的是，与此同时，我们也在把一辆车从你70岁的妈妈、以及在医院

sentences.en: working a 12-hour shift at the hospital.
sentences.zh: 连轴转12小时的护士身上移开。

sentences.en: So, here we go.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Without saving.
sentences.zh: Without saving。

sentences.en: From Beauty Pill describes things as they are.
sentences.zh: 选自 Beauty Pill Describes Things As They Are。

sentences.en: It's available on Bandcamp, so you can buy it right now without leaving your house.
sentences.zh: 它在 Bandcamp 上线了，所以你足不出户现在就能买到。

sentences.en: I think it's a masterpiece.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一部杰作。

sentences.en: But don't just take my word for it.
sentences.zh: 但不仅听我这么说。

sentences.en: Time Magazine named it one of the best albums of the decade in amongst Beyoncé and Kendrick Lamar,
sentences.zh: 《时代》杂志把它评为十年代最佳专辑之一，和碧昂丝以及肯德里克·拉马尔并列，

sentences.en: which is pretty amazing.
sentences.zh: 这真是太了不起了。

sentences.zh: 但我也建议你趁这段时间，通过关注，以及，

sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果能力允许的话，通过资金支持来支持任何你喜欢的艺术家。

sentences.en: It might be rough for a while, for many of them.
